messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: high error rate + CPU pressure in eu-west-az3. Service: inference-runtime. Priority: P1. page_id=PD12345
PagerDuty: Pager PD12345 fired (auto-retry 30s). Incident link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345
Marco: I'm oncall, picking this up — looking at metrics now.
Sara: seeing a spike in 5xxs for /v1/generate from eu-west-az3, qps up ~3x compared to baseline. latency p95 jumped to 2.8s.
Li: also seeing node evictions in az3: kube events show OOM kills on inference-worker pods, lots of pod restarts.
Marco: confirmed. autoscaler didn't scale fast enough. pods are getting evicted, replica count dropping from 24 -> 8.
Sara: routing shows a slow divert to fallback but not enough capacity in az2. Some requests are timing out before failover completes.
Marco: running quick health checks + tailing logs.
Marco: ```kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep eu-west-az3```
Marco: ```NAME                           READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-worker-az3-0         0/1     CrashLoop 12         3h
inference-worker-az3-1         1/1     Running   0          1h
...```
Li: logs show `RuntimeError: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` -> suggests GPU OOM during shard load.
Sara: stack traces match model shard load path. Could be quantization kernel or larger batch sizes.
Marco: temporary mitigation: scale down batch size and spin up extra CPU-backed fallback replicas, then divert traffic.
Marco: executing plan: 1) reduce batch size via config rollout 2) increase fallback pool in az2/az1 3) enable immediate routing divert for customer-critical routes 4) notify customers.
Marco: rolling config change: ```redwoodctl rollout --service inference-runtime --set batch_size=1 --env eu-west-az3```
Li: applied. new batch_size=1 on az3 nodes. watching.
Anya: 10-15 min until new pods stabilized in az2 fallback pool if we scale. I can take over if Marco needs break.
Marco: scaling fallback pool now: ```kubectl scale deployment inference-fallback --replicas=40 -n inference```
Sara: scaling triggered, cloud autoscaler requests submitted.
Incident Bot: Note: automatic fallback policy engaged for route /v1/generate -> divert to model-variant small-quantized.
PagerDuty: PD12345 acknowledged by Marco.
Marco: traffic start diverting. Monitoring: 5xx rate down from 4.2% -> 1.3% in 2m. p95 latency improving to 1.1s for diverted traffic.
Li: still a handful of CrashLoop pods — investigating if kernel versions mismatch w/ new driver. raising infra ticket.
Anya: if driver mismatch, might need node reprovision; for now we should keep divert until stable. I’ll prepare handoff notes.
Marco: marking impact: "Partial degradation in eu-west-az3 causing increased latency and errors for ~12% of global traffic. Failover reduced customer visible errors to <2% within 10m."
Sara: documenting affected customers: acct-234, acct-998 — CS team already looped via #customer-impact.
Marco: creating short postmortem stub in incidents tracker.
Anya: Marco — can you hand off active watch to me in 10m? I can own until full remediation and node reprovision finish.
Marco: handing off to Anya — switching duty. I leave logs+commands in thread. Please escalate to infra if node reprovision needed.
Marco: ```Handoff: investigating GPU OOM-led evictions in eu-west-az3. Actions taken: reduced batch_size, scaled fallback pool, diverted traffic to small-quantized variant. Current status: errors reduced, some az3 pods CrashLoop. Next: node driver check, potential reprovision. Contact infra oncall (ping @infra-oncall) if reprovision required.```
Anya: acknowledged. I'll coordinate with infra and CS. starting 15m watch.
PagerDuty: PD12345: escalation notice queued — next oncall: Li.
Li: I'll be on standby for infra-level changes. prepping kernel/driver logs and node reprovision playbook.
Incident Bot: Reminder: please add timeline + commit hashes for rollout changes.
Anya: added rollout id rollout-2026-03-15-az3-batch-sz to incident ticket.
Marco: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Leaving thread — ping me if anything urgent.
Anya: will update when node reprovision plan confirmed or when we can fully re-enable az3 for traffic.
Li: preliminary root cause hypothesis: sudden workload spike + batch config + GPU driver memory regression -> OOM during shard load. Will validate with infra.
Anya: next update in 20m or earlier if status changes.
Incident Bot: PD12345 resolved -> manual close by Anya after monitoring window.
Anya: closing note: monitoring stable for 30m, errors held <1.5%, az3 pod restarts continue but not causing new user errors due to divert. Keeping incident open for followup PM.
